name: fullmix_rescue
eq_intent: Correct broad tonal problems only after identifying narrow resonances and source damage.
compression_intent: Minimal glue or repair compression; 1.2:1 to 2:1 with 0.5 to 2 dB gain reduction.
de_esser_intent: Mix-bus de-essing only if sibilance is global; max 2 dB reduction and brightness guard required.
ms_eq_intent: Control low side energy and harsh side fizz while protecting centered vocal, kick, snare, and bass.
